episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Unable to afford a place with Kim Min Suk, Kang Sang Woong visits his father — who grants him a power that will test both his morals and his bank account.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Sang Woong calls Park Jung Ja for help when he finds himself in a crisis — only to end up in danger. Meanwhile, Jo Anna uses Min Suk as bait to lure him.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After realizing he's become a target, Sang Woong trains with Byun Ho In and Bang Eun Mi. Soon after, he contacts Jung Ja for help to face Anna's army.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Longing for a normal life, Sang Woong considers selling his power to the Mundane Vanguard — but Ho In attempts to stop him from making a mistake.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After narrowly escaping danger, Sang Woong, Ho In and Eun Mi find themselves taunted by Jo Nathan. Soon, they investigate a drug ring at a nightclub.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: After escaping another trap, Sang Woong realizes his regular life is taking a negative impact. But Anna comes forward with an unexpected proposal.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The bank scheme quickly turns perilous, pitting Sang Woong against Anna and Nathan. But Nathan lures him in by taking what matters most.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Fighting for his love, Sang Woong goes toe-to-toe with the Mundane Vanguard. Will he and his friends finally become the heroes they were meant to be?
